show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/VZMKNZ
show.description: A heartwarming festive tale that weaves magic, laughter, and love across two worlds. When Santa’s clumsy elf John accidentally lands in India, his chaotic inventions bring unexpected joy to a struggling family—leading to a true Christmas miracle. Meanwhile, a spoiled city girl, Ananya, discovers the beauty of simplicity and kindness in a small village. From the snowy North Pole to rural India, this is a story where every pareshani turns mithi with a little Christmas magic.
